title: tooling(objectui-readiness): make the objectui tree merge-ready in its own repo before cutover (objectstack#25685)
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#25685

Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25677 (sub-issue 2/6).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

One draft PR for the whole card, one commit per scope item in card order. Branch `claude/project-thread-dwhq6r`, base `main` at a3c0da922 (chore: release packages, #13289). Nothing under `.github/`, `AGENTS.md`, `.changeset/config.json` or any other governed surface is touched; the objectui tree is prepared in its own repo so the `ui/` import (ruling D1 / A+) merges without a follow-up fix-up commit.

## What changed, per item

### 1. One react line (commit 8474f4dfa)

- 34 manifests (root `package.json` devDependencies and `pnpm.overrides`, every `packages/*`, `apps/console`, `apps/site`, the three examples): `react` / `react-dom` 19.2.8 to 19.3.0, `@types/react` 19.2.18 to 19.3.0, `@types/react-dom` 19.2.4 to 19.3.0.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/scaffold-dependencies.ts`: `REACT_RANGE = '19.3.0'` and the `@types/react*` entries of the shared dev-dependency map, which the CLI anchor test compares to the root manifest.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` regenerated with `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` (1337 lines added / 1337 removed). It also carries item 2's single-zod resolution, because one install produced both.
- Changeset `.changeset/25685-one-react-line.md`: patch for the 30 published packages whose manifests moved.

Before: `grep -c '"react": "19.2.8"'` over the workspace manifests = 33; after = 0, and `pnpm ls react --depth 0` across the workspace resolves one `react@19.3.0`.

### 2. One zod range (commit 1d6a03800)

- `packages/types`, `components`, `app-shell`, `test-support`, `plugin-timeline`: `"zod": "^4.6.5"` (was `^4.4.3` x3 and `^4.6.1` x2).
- Changeset `.changeset/25685-one-zod-range.md` for the four published packages.

Before: three distinct declared ranges; after: one, and the lockfile holds a single `zod@4.6.7` for the workspace (the unrelated `zod@3.25.76` is a transitive dependency of a third-party tool and is unchanged).

### 3. `uiRoot()` instead of `.git` / `pnpm-workspace.yaml` lookups (commit 5cc535435)

- New `scripts/ui-root.mjs` (`UI_ROOT`, `uiRoot()`, derived from the helper's own location; node builtins only) and its declaration twin `scripts/ui-root.d.mts`: package tsconfigs have no `allowJs`, so without the twin every migrated package test's import is TS7016 (2195392f1 removed it, the Type Check job proved it needed, ae7fcc585 restored it). `check-lint-rule-coverage` reports a `.d.mts` as a file no ESLint config reaches, so its predicate-2 ledger (`UNREACHED_GROUPS`, exact paths) carries a row for it, owned by this PR; the gate's own test pins the unreached population as `scripts/ui-root.d.mts` + `vitest.config.mts`.
- Migrated: 15 `repoRoot()` walkers in package tests (types x7, components, plugin-calendar x2, plugin-gantt, app-shell x2, data-objectstack, core), the sdui-parser census IIFE, four `existsSync(join(root, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'))` sanity assertions (now `expect(root).toBe(uiRoot())`), and four scripts that shelled out to `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` (`cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census.mjs`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs`, `check-cross-repo-closer-outcome.mjs`). `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` now diffs with `--relative` and reads blobs as `rev:./path`, so it keeps working when the git toplevel is a parent of the ui root; its root is `gateRoot()` (753720692): the repository at the cwd via `--show-toplevel` — its self-test drives the gate against a scratch repository — narrowed to `uiRoot()` when the objectui tree lies inside it.
- New gate `scripts/check-ui-root-lookups.mjs` (`pnpm check:ui-root-lookups`; `--list`, `--json`, `--self-test` with 13 cases): a TypeScript-AST scan of `scripts/`, `packages/`, `apps/` for marker probes (`existsSync` / `statSync` / `lstatSync` / `accessSync` on `.git` or `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, directly, via a const binding or a template literal), `--show-toplevel` / `--git-common-dir` literals, and `find-up`. Allowlist is a ledger (a stale entry is red) with five entries: `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` (deleted at cutover), `scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` (its subject is the repository at the cwd, above) and three CLI product predicates that probe the USER's cwd (`app-generator.ts`, `workspace-vite.ts`, `app-generator.test.ts`).
- `scripts/check-test-path-roots.mjs` classifies `uiRoot()` / `UI_ROOT` as the self root (two new self-test cases).

Before: on `main` the fifteen walkers and four shell-outs resolved the root through `.git` / `pnpm-workspace.yaml` / `git rev-parse`, and `check-test-path-roots` reported 1264 self / 590 unclassified roots. After: `check-ui-root-lookups: OK (7796 files scanned, 55 parsed, 6 probes all on the allowlist, 5 allowlist entries live)`; `check-test-path-roots: OK`, 1264 self / 579 unclassified. The card's crude grep (A4) re-derived to 55 unique files on `main` (the card quoted 71); 20 package test files and 4 scripts were migrated, and the residue is comments, `readFileSync` DATA reads of the workspace globs, fixture writes, two `'.git'` directory skip-list entries and the allowlisted CLI predicates — the gate, not the grep, is the instrument that fails when a new lookup lands.

### 4. tsc heap for app-shell and console (commits 02eaff511, c464a4a3f)

- `packages/app-shell/package.json` and `apps/console/package.json`: the `tsc` of `build` and `type-check` runs as `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 tsc ...` — the spelling objectstack's `packages/spec` uses for the same purpose.
- `scripts/__tests__/helpers/build-program.ts`: `stripEnvAssignments()` skips the leading `NAME=value` words of a command before classifying the tool, so the two builds are still tsc runs in the `turbo-build-inputs` sweep and contribute their tsconfig chain.
- Why not the wrapper script the card suggested: a root `scripts/with-heap.mjs` (02eaff511) is a file outside the two packages, so `turbo-build-inputs.test.ts` requires it as a `$TURBO_ROOT$` input of `build`, and `docs-build-trigger.test.ts` then requires every such input in the docs job's pathspec in `ci.yml` — a `.github/workflows/**` edit the maintainer must approve. Shard 15 went red on the second gate; c464a4a3f removes the wrapper, its test and its turbo.json line. A heap ceiling is not a build input.

Measured (A3) with `tsc --noEmit --extendedDiagnostics` in this tree: app-shell `Memory used: 2234110K` (3915 files, 50.7 s), console `Memory used: 2355117K` (4122 files, 25.4 s). Both exceed what the default old-space limit left on the merged-tree runner in the spike measurement; 4096 MB has headroom.

### 5. Vite chunk tests derived from the workspace layout (commit 5c76fe324)

- New `scripts/vite-objectstack-workspace.ts`: `candidateFrameworkPackagesDir(consoleDir)` (`../../../packages` from `ui/apps/console`), `frameworkPackagesDir(consoleDir)` (that directory when it exists, else `null`) and `workspaceChunkTests(dir | null)` returning `{ vendor, spec, lint }` regexes that keep the baseline `node_modules` / pnpm-store spellings and add an anchored, escaped `dir/` alternative (vendor excludes `lint/`, which must stay lazy). With `null` — standalone — it returns `BASELINE_CHUNK_TESTS`, the baseline literals byte for byte (dde5e6dac): `vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts` pins the vendor literal as one of objectui#4854's flagged surfaces, and an unconditional arm had moved it (shard 7).
- `apps/console/vite.config.ts` uses them for `VENDOR_OBJECTSTACK_TEST`, `SPEC_MODULE_TEST` and the lazy-linter assertion.
- Ported from spike commit 3efb112efb (A5) with the unit test it lacked, `scripts/__tests__/vite-objectstack-workspace.test.ts`: standalone the three tests are the baseline literals; a `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/...` id is matched in both layouts; `<monorepo>/packages/spec/dist/x.mjs` is matched by spec and vendor; `<monorepo>/packages/lint/...` is excluded from vendor and matched by lint; a sibling directory, a FILE named `packages` and objectui's own `ui/packages/*` are not matched.
- `scripts/vite-objectstack-client-dist.ts` judged and left alone: its chunk test has no `node_modules` assumption, and `packageResolvesFrom` walks `node_modules/name`, which workspace links satisfy.

### 6. `pnpm typecheck` alias and `workspace:` spec ranges (commit 11bc20922)

- Root `package.json`: `"typecheck": "turbo run type-check"`.
- `scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`: `WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL`; `minVersionOf(range, { workspaceVersion })` reads `workspace:*` / `^` / `~` / bare as the workspace package's own version and `workspace:^18.1.0` as its range tail; `workspaceSpecVersion(root)` reads the installed `@objectstack/spec/package.json`; a `workspace:` range met without that version throws instead of passing.
- `scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs`: `installedVersion`, `floorOfRange`, `planRanges(..., { workspaceVersionOf })`.
- `packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/normalize-list-view.declaredSpecFloor-9012.test.ts`: `floorOf` reads a `workspace:` range as the installed spec's own version (the old `workspace:* is not a floor` assertion replaced by that test).
- Tests appended to `scripts/__tests__/check-spec-range-floors.test.ts` and `scripts/__tests__/objectstack-floor.test.ts`.

Other readers of `@objectstack/spec` ranges that were NOT changed (they do not fail on `workspace:` today): `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (`majorOfRange`) and `scripts/sync-quick-reference-release.mjs`.

## Verification (local, this worktree)

Install: `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` against a stand-in `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` (sibling objectstack checkout at 3efb112efb; pin manifests and sibling manifests have identical dependency names and exports, all 18.1.0, so `.objectstack-pin` and the `file:` lockfile snapshots are unchanged). react / react-dom / @types 19.3.0 resolved.

Under the shared verify lock (`--concurrency=2`, 4096 MB heap):
- `turbo run build` for the dependency closure of console, cli and app-shell: 34 tasks, 34 successful.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build` (vite build + sdui manifest + plugin), `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli build`, `type-check`, `test`: all exit 0.
- 24 touched package test files (the 21 migrated files, `declaredSpecFloor-9012`, cli `app-generator`, `console-vite-alias-closure-4925`, `doc-version-claims`): 24 passed, 325 tests.

Unlocked (the dev's run, before the five red shards below): `pnpm type-check:scripts` exit 0; `scripts/__tests__` suites naming an edited script (`ui-root`, `with-heap`, `check-ui-root-lookups`, `check-test-path-roots`, `vite-objectstack-workspace`, `objectstack-floor`, `check-spec-range-floors`, `react-peer-range-norm-3741`, `quick-reference-commands-4149`, `turbo-type-check-inputs`, `turbo-build-inputs`, `turbo-test-inputs`, `turbo-lint-inputs`, `scripts-type-check`): all green. Gates exit 0: `check:lockfile-integrity`, `check:lockfile-dedupe`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:ui-root-lookups`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:pre-install-import-graph`, `check:control-bytes`, `type-check:coverage`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`. `eslint` over all 41 changed source files: 0 errors (4 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings on lines this PR did not touch).

`pnpm check:spec-floors` after the build: exit 1 with two `floor-too-low` findings (`@object-ui/auth` `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_EXTERNAL`, `@object-ui/types` `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource` against the FETCHED `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.x`). Identical verdict with the unmodified gate script from `main` on the same dists, and both symbols are referenced by `main`'s source, so this is pre-existing and not introduced here; CI's `spec-range-floors.yml` runs the gate with `--cross-check`, which is the measurement that counts.

NOT MEASURED locally (CI's): the full `turbo run test`, `lint` and `type-check` across the workspace, `check:published-dist`, performance budgets, the react 19.3.0 runtime behaviour beyond building and the touched test files.

## Epic PM follow-up (commits 6f3d9d538, c464a4a3f, dde5e6dac, 753720692, 2195392f1, ae7fcc585)

The first CI run on 11bc20922 had five red shards, all in `scripts/__tests__`: `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask` (the `uiRoot()` test stripped comments with its own regex), `vite-objectstack-spec-dist` (vendor literal moved), `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (gate rooted off its scratch repository), `check-lint-rule-coverage` (`ui-root.d.mts` unreached), `docs-build-trigger` (new turbo input not in the governed docs pathspec). The second run's Type Check job then failed on `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (TS7016, the twin deleted by 2195392f1 was needed); ae7fcc585 restores it with a ledger row. Fixed as described in items 3–5; verified locally after `pnpm run setup` (the pin built): `vitest run scripts/__tests__` 194 files passed / 2 skipped, `vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts` 84 passed, `check-lint-rule-coverage` + `ui-root` tests green with the twin, `pnpm type-check:scripts` exit 0, `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/data-objectstack --filter=@object-ui/types --filter=@object-ui/core` 6/6 tasks, `check:ui-root-lookups` OK.

## Acceptance notes

- One PR instead of the two the claim mentioned, per the ruling; commit order equals card order 1 to 6.
- The lockfile effect of item 2 lands in commit 1 (a single `pnpm install` regenerates the whole file); commit 2 holds the manifest hunks and the changeset.
- The heap flag is an inline `NODE_OPTIONS=` prefix rather than the card's cross-platform wrapper: a root wrapper is a build input, and a new build input must be in the governed docs pathspec (item 4). The flag changes the heap, not the program, so turbo's cache verdicts are unaffected.
- The A4 crude-grep residue (data reads of `pnpm-workspace.yaml` globs in `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`, `release-github-releases.mjs` and the workspace-reading tests; `'.git'` in two directory skip lists) is deliberate: those are not root lookups. The `pnpm-workspace.yaml` DATA readers will need a path once `ui/` has no workspace file of its own; that belongs to the carrier sub-issue, and is listed in the report.
- Stand-in pin (A1): the sibling checkout is one day newer than the pin SHA; no dependency-name or export surface differs, so no manifest or lockfile snapshot moved. `--write-manifests` was not passed.
